memories.content: The council is a body of elected members. Its standing orders require formal adoption of the precept at the January meeting. The council has a chair and a clerk. The precept proposal has been prepared but not yet formally adopted.

Kettlewell Parish Council's January meeting is scheduled to occur after the simulation start time. The meeting agenda includes the item to formally adopt next year's precept. The council's standing orders mandate that this adoption occur at the January meeting.
